name: Claude Opus 5.5
short: Anthropic's Opus 5.5 (1M/128K, $4/$20) for long-horizon coding; TB4 66.4%, AA Index 58.
standout: The long-horizon specialist of the Claude family: it holds an entire project in mind across extended agentic runs and stays coherent where smaller models drift.
tradeoff: Premium Opus-lane pricing means it should be reserved for work that genuinely needs the depth; everyday coding is better served by the Sonnet/Haiku tiers at a fraction of the cost.
